OpenLF2 needs the original game's installer: LF2_v2.0a.exe

Place it in this folder (ports/openlf2/conf/), next to config.json.
The file name must be exactly LF2_v2.0a.exe.

Download:
  https://lf2.net/LF2_v2.0a.exe
  https://web.archive.org/web/20260921121026id_/https://lf2.net/LF2_v2.0a.exe  (archive copy)

If the device is online, the game also offers to download it for you on first start.
